name: Senken-Sha Mikoto
source:
Mikoto is a "Senken-Sha", a girl who can see ghost of deceased people. During her day she is confronted with them everywhere and has to solve their problems.

"Senken-Sha Mikoto" is a series of episodes, released in seasons.
